SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.sale_type, p.brand, p.product_name, p.product_name_jp, p.description, p.price_jpy, p.original_price_jpy, p.stock, p.sales_count, p.weight, p.original_url, p.thumbnail_url, CASE WHEN gb.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'SUCCESS'
WHEN gb.status = 'RECRUITING' AND gb.end_date > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND gb.end_date <= DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 3 DAY ) THEN 'CLOSING_SOON'
WHEN gb.status = 'RECRUITING' THEN 'ACTIVE'
ELSE gb.status END AS status, p.created_at, p.updated_at
FROM PRODUCT p
ORDER BY ( p.sales_count + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST w WHERE w.product_id = p.product_id) * 5 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CART_ITEM ci WHERE ci.product_id = p.product_id) * 3 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW rv WHERE rv.product_id = p.product_id) * 4 ) DESC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.updated_at DESC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY p.price_jpy ASC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY ( p.sales_count + COALESCE((SELECT AVG(rv.rating) FROM REVIEW rv WHERE rv.product_id = p.product_id), 0) * 2 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW rc WHERE rc.product_id = p.product_id) * 4 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST w WHERE w.product_id = p.product_id) * 5 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CART_ITEM ci WHERE ci.product_id = p.product_id) * 3 + COALESCE(gb.current_quantity / NULLIF(gb.target_quantity, 0), 0) * 10 ) DESC, p.product_id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
